local_verification.session_jsonl_keys: agent/sessions/**/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl (4 files on this PC): customType, cwd, display, id, content, details.{currentDate,cwd}, data.{sessionId,boundAt,repoPathHash,turnKey,...}, message.{api,content[]...} - a Pi-style session log with typed entries
